status: W2 F2C-FALLBACK (MECH-F2C / PCB-PWRC-2): the board-side contract of PWR-C in its component-side frame, ported from the W2 PWRJ-F2C probe (origin/wip/w2-pwrj-f2c 23337c1a); not generated by mechanical/build.py
why: PWR-C faces -z (its parts face the battery tray), so its component-side view is the mirror of the enclosure frame that mechanical/params/boards.json PWR_C uses (origin enclosure (4, 4), board x = enclosure x - 4). pcb/board_gen.py and pcb/check_boards.py draw a board in its contract frame without a mirror, so the PCB takes this component-side proposal (x = 160 - enclosure x, y = enclosure y - 4), as the small boards take theirs; build/kicad/boards/PWR_C/make_spec.py checks that it is the mechanical contract mirrored (mirror_check) once the sr-rx-mech patch carries it.
frame: board mm, viewed from the component side, which faces the battery tray (-z): x = 160 - enclosure x, y = enclosure y - 4; origin = enclosure (160, 4). The board back lies 0.5 mm from the front-wall inner face (board z 65.48-67.08), parts hang towards the tray down to z 58.98 (6.5 mm), 0.58 mm above the tray front face z 58.4.

sources.envelope: pwr-decision.json fallback F2-C and the PWR-C+R proposal of the SHRINK study (pwr-study.json proposals[1]): enclosure x 4-160, y 4-37.5, z 58.4-67.58, parts 6.5 mm or lower, an 18 mm hole for the V2 vent at enclosure (80, 21); judges 2 and 3 found no layout item, structure box or harness route there on wip/w2-int 4d459155
sources.corner: enclosure outer corner radius 14 and wall 2.5 (mechanical/params/mechanical.json outer): the inner-wall arc of the lower-left corner is centred at enclosure (14, 14) with radius 11.5; the 5.5 mm chamfer at board (150.5, 0)-(156, 5.5) keeps its midpoint 10.25 mm from that centre (1.25 mm clear)
sources.holes: design choice (W2 F2C-FALLBACK, from the probe): four holes on front-shell standoff pads; the probe hole at the top-left corner made way for the W-C2 exit J120 and the one beside the vent for J119/J118; the board back lies 0.5 mm from the front-wall inner face, which leaves no insert depth: the fixing is OPEN for MECH (build/15 W2 F2C-FALLBACK)

stackup.fab: JLC04161H-7628 4-layer FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner (as PWR-A, build/15 'Шари')
stackup.components: top side only (SMD and THT); THT pin tails trimmed flush (1.0 mm or less) towards the front wall, polyimide on the back

PWR_C.name: PWR-C front-slab power-entry board (F2-C): E1 battery front end, INA228 shunt monitor, Pololu #2813 switch, E5 IMU service, W-C1/W-C2 interconnect
PWR_C.outline_note: 156 x 33.5 = enclosure x 4-160, y 4-37.5, with the 5.5 mm chamfer at the lower-left inner-wall arc (board lower right in the component-side frame) and a 3.9 x 1.7 mm corner notch at enclosure x 156.1-160, y 35.8-37.5 (W2 F2C-FALLBACK, MECH-F2C): the passage of the harness branch S02B (13 x 22 AWG, OD 5.21) between this corner and the display clamp boss (163.8, 46) is 5.56 mm wide without it (bundle + 2 x 0.5 = 6.21); with it the S02B leg keeps >= 0.5 mm (rule R-PWRB-EXIT) (board upper left in the component-side frame, x 0-3.9, y 31.8-33.5)
PWR_C.cutouts_note: the V2 vent passage, enclosure centre (80, 21) = board (80, 17), as an 18 x 18 mm rectangular cut-out (the recorded 18 mm hole, milled square in the probe)
PWR_C.max_component_height_note: the slab between the board face z 65.48 and the tray front face z 58.4 leaves 7.08 mm; 6.5 keeps 0.58 mm clear (F2-C record)

edge_zones.use: S05 from PACK_FUSE J117 (J105 lands; the PACK_FUSE carrier stands 1.7 mm from this edge, so only the S05 end, which belongs to it, leaves here)
W-C2 = S02C to CTRL (J120, PHD side entry, opening up), S10 (J108, J112), S12 (J115), W-C1 = S42 to PWR-A J106/J107 (J118, J119), S32 (J507), S05 NTC (J109), S11 (J113, J114)

place.mount: four M3 positions on front-shell standoff pads; fitted before the battery tray; fixing OPEN (MECH, build/15 W2 F2C-FALLBACK: 0.5 mm from the board back to the front wall leaves no insert depth)
